title: Photography and more!
text: While the focus of this tour was the photography, its tips and technics, Andrei made sure I knew the history of places we were visiting. He is a knowledgeable photo pro and an engaging guide. The two hours flew by!
author: valo940

title: great photo workshop with Barcelona flavour
text:
I booked the tour four my daughter (13y) passioned about photography and myself, and we were lucky to be just the 2 of us on the tour. We absolutely enjoyed it. We received very useful tips and advices for taking great pictures, pros and cons of different the photo equipments. All this together with interesting stories about Barcelona, while walking some narrow pitoresque back streets of the city.
Thank you Andrei for this great experience!
author: 39stefanap

title: Phototour barcelona
text: Very nice tour with expirienced guide. Balance between facts from history and photo fun. Time scedule was ok.
author: Keeses

title: Excellent introduction to photography and basic Barcelona history
text: Andrei was very knowledgeable and approachable, interested in teaching the basics of composition, as well as providing historical knowledge of Barcelona.
author: Ken M

title: Great tour
text: I really appreciate Andrei patience and knowledge as he shows me how to do composition in my photos. I used my IPhone and is was grate. And the next year will take a tour with him again. Recommend it!
author: maciejd189

title: A great experience
text: What a great guide and experience. We had a great time scurrying about some of the side streets of the gothic part of town. I was shown elements of this interesting area that I would normally have walked passed. It was raining in the morning quite heavily and I was offered another time out of courtesy but decided to go ahead with the tour anyway due to my tight schedule. I was still accommodated and the weather got better as the tour went along.
author: AustralianSteve

title: Photo tips – great advice
text: I loved your tips on camera setting and hints on improving the composition in my photos. One of your highlight, for me, it was the part of the tour where I could see your way of shooting – seeing shots through your eyes is inspirational. Also knowing the stories behind the places that I shoot were very nice as I had the whole picture in my mind. Inspirational experience! Keep the good work Andrei!
author: Cipi27

title: The best way to tour a city is through the eyes of a photographer
text: I loved this! Andrei’s deep passion for photography shines through his teaching, plus his knowledge of the city made for a wonderfully unique tour of Barcelona. He also taught me about the tools on my camera so I can stop relying on the Auto function. I highly recommend this experience if you want to learn how to tour a city and view photography with a new perspective.
author: LGLG123123

title: Very good experience
text: Andrei's tour is a good method to explore the city as he provide a lot of tips for nowadays moment, history facts to understand the past & the local culture and practice photography tools that helps to improve the way you take your picture. I'm passionate about photography, never exceed but with Andrei's advice and rules I felts I learn a lot and I'm more confident to play in my photos. Practically is a 3 in 1 experience and I recommending it!
author: Ioan123

title: Very nice tour
